summary.intent: Continue the ongoing multi-worker effort on the caliper repo: launch the Storybook live-upgrade and S7b fallback-off workers, and move the agent working rules into CLAUDE.md so briefs stop repeating them.
summary.outcome: Two Opus workers were started (feat/storybook-live-upgrade, feat/fallback-off-mode). Draft docs-only PR #460 (trail #259) was pushed with the worker contract in CLAUDE.md, and the PR body was written. It is blocked on Entire Gates and awaiting the user's merge.

repo: Rust version is pinned by `rust-version = "1.99"` in Cargo.toml, not by a rust-toolchain file; mise can force rustc 1.98.1, so MISE_RUST_VERSION=1.99.1 is exported before commits.
CLAUDE.md contains an Entire-managed block; agent rules go below it.
Pre-commit hook and cargo deny run on commit; --no-verify must never be used.
Merge-commit policy applies, and a PR merged into its base branch is not on main (lesson from #444).
Toolchain pitfalls include rust-objcopy and strip.
PRs are linked to Entire trails with `entire trail link <n> --branch <b> --base main --repo gh/orin-dx/caliper`, followed by a short sleep before looking up the PR number with gh.
Worker artifact format: PR body file, 120-word final message, and a call cap.
workflow: Measured waste of about 5M tokens across workers came from repeated full-suite runs that CI already performs, Opus on mechanical work, and re-derived PR bodies; the fix is a shared contract in CLAUDE.md.
Subagent briefs were 800-1,500 words each; moving common rules into CLAUDE.md shrinks briefs to task, owned files and call cap.
Concurrent worker cap is 3; PR bodies are written to a $TMPDIR file and applied with gh pr edit --body-file.
Workers should stop and report instead of hacking internals when public APIs are insufficient (Storybook 11 beta).

friction: I first wrote that a rust-toolchain file pins Rust, which was wrong, and I had to amend the commit.
The PR-body command was run twice, once before ExitWorktree and once after, so the body was effectively rewritten with minor wording changes.
PR #460 is BLOCKED on Entire Gates.
Entire has not yet re-reviewed the symlink fix on #455.
Subagents branch from origin/main, so the new CLAUDE.md rules will not reach workers until #460 merges.
open_items: User needs to merge #455, #458, #459, #460 and release PR #396.
Verify whether subagents load the CLAUDE.md before it merges (currently unverified).
S7b worklist should drive S7c to S7e, with new suite rows for constructs only the structural path covers.
Storybook worker should delete warmUp and fillAfter if the live upgrade supersedes them.
The oracle run is still the user's call on cost, best done after the S7b worklist and the batch settle.
